items.title: Titan Flooring - VISTA (Markham)
items.summary: Joanna (the supplier rep) sent new store and skid trim price lists dated Oct 16, said 8 ft baseboard is sold out with 7 ft and 12 ft available and restock expected mid/end of next month, and credited a small amount to Helen's account. Helen and Joey Hou (who appear on our side) ordered trim for pickup; Joanna also asked Helen to call her back. Nothing is awaiting a reply; review the new price lists in the archive.

needs_attention: Sender labels in VISTA (Markham) are all 'Them', including Helen and Joey Hou who appear to be our own side; sent_at is mostly null, so message timing is archive time only.
